registryLegalName: Application for Set-Aside, Dismissal and Discharge, I.C. § 19-2604(1)

primaryStatutoryAuthority.description: Where sentence was imposed but suspended, or was withheld, on the defendant's application and a satisfactory showing of compliance with probation, or graduation from an authorized drug court or mental health court program, the court may terminate the sentence or set aside the plea or conviction and finally dismiss the case and discharge the defendant. Final dismissal restores civil rights. It does not hide the record and it is not an expungement.

counselFlags: Sex-offender registration exclusion: an offense requiring registration under I.C. § 18-8304 is not subject to dismissal or reduction under § 19-2604. "Conviction" here includes a plea or finding of guilt notwithstanding the form of the judgment or a withheld judgment.
Venue is the sentencing court, but the accepted filing vehicle in that court — statewide form, approved template, or county-specific practice — is unresolved, so no caption or venue block is drafted.

Waiting period: the registry records no waiting period for either § 19-2604 route. Relief turns on a satisfactory showing of compliance with probation, or graduation from an authorized drug court or mental health court program, not on elapsed time.
No verification or notarization statute is identified for an I.C. § 19-2604 application, and the application's own required elements are unresolved. Nothing is filled.
Registry release blocker (open): whether the 2024, 2025 or 2026 sessions amended I.C. § 67-3004 or I.C. § 19-2604 has not been confirmed. The section text relied on may be out of date.
Idaho relief is not expungement and does not hide the record. Final dismissal under § 19-2604(1) restores civil rights; it does not seal or destroy the record, and a participant must be told so.
Filing fee: no fee for an I.C. § 19-2604 application is established by any committed Idaho evidence. No amount may be stated to a participant; confirm with the clerk of the sentencing court.

There is no render against which a negative fixture could assert anything, and authoring one would mean drafting the very pleading the recorded dependency says cannot be drafted. The anti-invention contract for this track is carried by that dependency, not by a fixture.

The Idaho state pack commits only index.ts and all50-build-metadata.ts — no pathways, filing-instructions, official-forms or required-fields file exists for Idaho.
